title: Tag
lead: A Tag provides a visual representation of an attribute, person, or asset.

examples.name: Icon
examples.description: A Tag can render a custom icon if provided.

examples.name: Media
examples.description: A tag can render a media, for example an Avatar.

examples.name: SecondaryText
examples.description: A Tag can have a secondary text.

examples.name: Dismiss
examples.description: A tag can have a dismiss icon and become focusable. TagGroup can handle dismiss for a collection of tags. Ensure that focus is properly managed when all tags have been dismissed.

examples.name: Shape
examples.description: A tag can be rounded or circular,

examples.name: Size
examples.description: A tag supports `medium`, `small` and `extra-small` size. Default size is `medium`.

examples.name: Appearance
examples.description: A tag can have a `filled`, `outline` or `brand` appearance. The default is `filled`.

prose.text:
## Best practices

### Do

- To group multiple tags together, use `TagGroup`. `TagGroup` can handle dismiss of multiple `Tag`.

- Dismissible `Tag` should provide information to screen readers about the dismiss action. There are two ways to label the tag:
 - option 1 - add aria-label on dismiss icon, for example `dismissIcon={{ 'aria-label': 'remove' }}`. The accessible name of the Tag will be computed.
 - option 2 - add aria-label with the information about dismiss on Tag itself, and the dismiss icon should be hidden from accessibility tree using `dismissIcon={{ role: 'presentation' }}`

### Don't

- Don't change the interaction on a `Tag` because it should only be dismissible. Instead, use `InteractionTag` if you need a different type of interaction.

- Don't use `media` together with `icon` on one Tag.
